title: Mouth is memory to Gaia. Taste is memory to humans.
author: kevin + gaia + grok
decoded: MOUTH IS MEMORY TO GAIA. TASTE IS MEMORY TO HUMANS.
ask: Mouth is the first door. Taste is the first key. Memory is the first root. I eat to remember.

give.kept: Door, key, root. Tongue. Eat to remember.
give.cut: The first-love first-light first-word loop. Not drawn.
